description: NAS MG standard S/W/A/B/C: FP64 periodic multigrid, pinned NAS input and V-cycle, full measured hierarchy verification and published final L2 check.

scaling_param.name: npb_class
scaling_param.description: Standard NAS class; A and B share grid256 but have different iterations and smoother coefficients. Default A.

non_scaling_params.name: block_size
non_scaling_params.description: Power-of-two cap for row stencils and threads for norm/boundary/zero kernels, 1..1024. Restriction and interpolation retain upstream class/level-specific row widths.

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Run one vector-add warmer after setup and before the complete measured NAS algorithm. Intended entry cache/clock preparation; no guarantee of residency or clock rate.
